title: KestrelCare Trip Interruption Claims Filed by the Holder
content:
## Coverage

A KestrelCare Vehicle Service Contracts trip interruption reimbursement covers lodging and meals while a covered breakdown keeps the holder away from home, and applies only when the breakdown happened at least the plan's trip interruption minimum distance from the holder's residential address. It is booked on the plan's history as a trip interruption reimbursement entry on the repair order; it is paid to the holder and does not change the coverage remaining.

**Timing of the amount.** A trip interruption reimbursement is not fixed until the facility has been paid for the repair work on the repair order that stranded the holder.

## Filing: `file_trip_interruption_claim_d37559b2`

The claim is the holder's own filing for the lodging and meals they paid. The representative unlocks `file_trip_interruption_claim_d37559b2` as a customer tool and hands it over; the customer themselves runs it. One run books one trip interruption reimbursement entry on the contract's history with the repair order, the trip days and the reimbursement amount.

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `service_contract_id` | the reference number of the holder's KestrelCare service contract, as the representative reads it from the service contract lookup and gives it to the holder | identifier |
| `repair_order_number` | the repair facility's repair order number for the breakdown, copied exactly as printed on the holder's repair order | verbatim, character for character |
| `trip_days` | the trip days being reimbursed | integer, 0 or more |
| `reimbursement_amount` | the reimbursement the holder is paid, as the representative states it | USD, 2 decimals, rounded to the nearest cent |

## Return

On success the reimbursement appears in the contract's service history and the receipt carries `status` (the string "filed"), `warranty_txn_id` (reference of the new reimbursement entry), `repair_order_number`, `trip_days` and `reimbursement_amount` (USD with 2 decimals).
